Mega Evolution series · POR

Perfect Order

Released March 27, 2026 · 124 cards

StandardExpanded

Perfect Order is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on March 27, 2026. Its main set has 88 cards, plus 36 secret rares numbered beyond the set (124 in total). It includes 91 Pokémon, 30 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
